text:
maya: Hey all — I pushed updates to PR #562 and addressed the review comments from yesterday. PTAL when you have a sec. Summary: moved batching logic into queue_manager, added unit + e2e tests, and set max_batch_size to 64 for model_x to smooth p50 latency. Rebased onto main and kept the feature flag off.

sam: Thanks — looking now. Quick q: did you change the default batching for all models or only model_x?

maya: Only model_x in config defaults. CLI flag unchanged. Diff snippet:
```
config/defaults.yaml
models:
  model_x:
    max_batch_size: 64
```

jordan: LGTM overall. Left one tiny comment about a log line (nit). If you fix that I'll approve.

maya: Fixed the log and pushed a new commit. Also rebased. CI green :white_check_mark:

ploy-bot: deploy-bot: tests passed on main/PR-562 (linux) — all checks green

priya: Approving now. @jordan do you want me to wait for your approval before merge?

jordan: No need to wait — go ahead @maya. I'm adding my approval now.

maya: Merging in ~10m after a quick smoke test. Thanks everyone :rocket:
